notes: pair_weights, roster, common_bidder and audit_references above are placeholders. Set them to Max's match mix, empty `pending`, and set launch_enabled to true.

A bot under gen6_bots is built from its base bot's spec in the source run: same policy net, belief net (used only by a 'gen5' switch) and sample count; near_tie 0; engine gen6; the three artifacts above; and the Gen5 bidder as the lead net's feature extractor.
Move an entry from gen6_variants_for_ablation to gen6_bots to add that variant as its own bot.

common_bidder names the bot whose bidder bids all four seats in the common condition. 5RZ32 keeps the common condition on Gen5 auctions, which the two nets were trained on; a Gen6 bot there puts the common condition on the graded bidder's auctions.
